about_the_game:
Continuum Keeper is a psychological horror puzzle game where you monitor surveillance cameras across unstable realities and report Fractures—distortions in time, space, and logic that threaten to collapse the multiverse.

As a Continuum Keeper, your job is to:

  • Watch multiple live camera feeds across locations like a gas station and a luxury subway train.

  • Spot Fractures—such as shifting objects, missing items, mysterious figures, or impossible changes in the environment.

  • Report the correct location where a Fracture is occurring to prevent destabilization.

  • Survive your shift and maintain the stability of reality.

Features:

  • Randomized Fractures: No two playthroughs are exactly the same. Fractures appear in different ways each time.

  • Multiple Environments: Monitor cameras in a gas station and a luxury subway train, with more locations planned.

  • Progressive Story Unfolding: Discover the origins of the Fractures and your role in protecting the timelines.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Experience surreal distortions, unsettling imagery, and creeping existential dread.

  • Challenge and Replayability: Every shift tests your attention to detail and ability to adapt under pressure.

Fail to catch too many Fractures, and reality collapses—ending your shift... and everything else.

Will you be able to hold you reality  together?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror elements, including disturbing imagery, surreal distortions of reality, and themes of existential dread. Some players may find the content unsettling or anxiety-inducing. It may also feature blood and other disturbing visuals.
